headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 5, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels suffered a 3-1 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with Tyler O'Neill leading the Orioles' offense with a home run. The New York Mets secured a 6-2 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Sean Manaea earning the win and Luis Torrens leading the Mets' offense with a 3-hit, 4-RBI performance. The Cincinnati Reds secured a 5-4 victory over the Athletics, with Julian Garcia earning the win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their team's availability. Hunter Greene has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Cincinnati Reds due to right elbow soreness. Sam Bachman has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Los Angeles Angels due to right forearm radial nerve inflammation. Patrick Corbin has been transferred to the 60-day injured list by the Toronto Blue Jays due to a left teres major strain. Trey Yesavage has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Toronto Blue Jays due to left knee inflammation. James Wood has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Washington Nationals due to a left oblique strain. Jeffrey Springs has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Athletics due to right hip discomfort. Nick Kurtz has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Athletics due to a strained right thumb.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. The Athletics acquired Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee. The Miami Marlins also traded Victor Vodnik to the Colorado Rockies for Connor Norby and Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Angels Fall to Orioles in 3-1 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels suffered a 3-1 loss to the Baltimore Orioles in their recent matchup. Tyler O'Neill led the Orioles' offense with a home run, his eighth of the season.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Guardians 6-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 6-2 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Sean Manaea earning the win after 6.0 innings pitched. Luis Torrens led the Mets' offense with a 3-hit, 4-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Reds Edge Athletics in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 5-4 victory over the Athletics, with Julian Garcia earning the win. Brady Singer led the Athletics' pitching effort, throwing 6.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 3 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall to Phillies in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals were defeated 5-0 by the Philadelphia Phillies, marking their loss in the game. Jesús Luzardo led the Phillies to victory, pitching 8.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Astros in Thrilling 5-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a narrow win over the Houston Astros, with Jesús Sánchez and Ernie Clement contributing key hits in the victory. Hunter Brown was a standout on the mound for the Astros, but ultimately fell short in a 5-4 loss.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs edged the Los Angeles Dodgers 7-6 in a close contest. Shohei Ohtani and Mookie Betts led the Dodgers' offense, while Shota Imanaga pitched well for the Cubs.

top_news.title: **Reds' Hunter Greene Lands on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Cincinnati Reds right-hander Hunter Greene has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow soreness, effective retroactive to August 2, 2026.

top_news.title: **Athletics Acquire RHP Seth Johnson in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Seth Johnson to the Athletics on August 3, 2026, in exchange for RF Colby Thomas.
